name: Chile
summary: Chile gives two-year temporary residence (leading to permanent residence after about two years) for an investment of USD 500,000 in a productive activity, for rentistas living on passive income, for foreign pensioners and for people with a Chilean work contract. There is no digital nomad visa. EU, US and other passports use the same routes.
naturalisation: Five years of residence under Law 21.325 and the Constitution (permanent residence first); Spanish and clean record (not read in a source this session).
dual_citizenship_note: Chile does not require renunciation of another nationality (general position; not source-checked in this session).

routes.name: Temporary residence for investors and executives
routes.summary: Two-year temporary residence for investing at least USD 500,000 in a productive activity in Chile, with a sponsorship letter from InvestChile.
routes.requirements: Investment of at least USD 500,000 (or equivalent) in producing goods or services in Chile; InvestChile sponsorship letter; description of the investment; criminal record. Also covers executives and specialised staff of companies in which a foreign investor holds at least 10%. Extension requires proof of progress on the investment. Law 21.325.
routes.physical_presence: Not stated in the sources reviewed

routes.processing_time: 6 to 8 months for temporary residence decisions in 2026 (guide)
routes.tax_note: More than 183 days in 12 months makes a person tax resident; domicile can make them taxable from day one.

routes.name: Temporary residence for rentistas
routes.summary: Two-year residence for people living on recurring passive income such as rents and dividends. No income threshold is fixed in law.
routes.requirements: Recurring passive income from rents, dividends, interest or annuities; freelance or remote-work income does not count. No codified income threshold; guides mention USD 1,000 to 2,000 a month as a practical level. Applied for from abroad through the SERMIG portal. Valid 2 years, renewable; permanent residence generally after about 24 months. Law 21.325 and Decree 177/2022 per guides.

routes.name: Temporary residence for retirees (jubilado)
routes.summary: Two-year residence for retirees with a recurring foreign pension. No pension amount is fixed in the sources reviewed.
routes.requirements: Recurring pension from outside Chile; no amount stated in the sources reviewed; 2-year validity and a route to permanent residence.

routes.name: Temporary residence for work (employment contract)
routes.summary: Ordinary work residence with a Chilean employment contract. Remote pay from a foreign employer does not qualify.
routes.requirements: Employment contract with a Chilean employer; remote salaries from abroad do not qualify for the work visa (expat.cl). Chile has no dedicated digital nomad visa in 2026; remote workers use tourist status short-term or the rentista visa for passive income only.
